description: Search deduped job reqs (including the hidden-ATS index). Charges 1 credit per unique job. Searches estimated above 50 credits return confirmation_required and a confirm_token: show the estimate to the user, and only repeat the call with that confirm_token once they agree.

company.description: Company name or domain to match.

confirm_token.description: Token from a confirmation_required reply, to approve that exact call.

title.description: Job title to match, e.g. 'Backend Engineer'.

name: find_reqs
